observations: Two white-outlined skeletal figures stand upright at left, their ribbed torsos and claw-like hands drawn in thin looping lines against a blue-grey ground.
A dense web of red diagonal lines crosses the entire composition, layered over a large black and yellow form at center-right that coils with concentric yellow curves.
A small pink figure with a spiky crown sits in the lower right corner in simple closed outlines, while jagged zigzag lines in yellow and blue run along the upper edge.
reading: Two skeletal forms at left read as hollow and exposed; a dense coiling black mass threaded with yellow dominates the right. Red lines cut across both zones without settling, giving the surface a restless, pressurized feeling. The small pink figure in the corner sits apart, almost calm by contrast. The image holds competing claims on attention without resolving them.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #232 and nnxyz nnotb #234. Where #232 holds to warm horizontal bands and a near-monochrome palette, #233 breaks into multi-figure chaos and a full spectrum of competing hues. Title order and recorded creation order align here.

connections.reason: Both works layer dense crossing lines over multi-colored grounds and include small outlined figures with exaggerated features, though #127 compresses everything into a single close-up form while #233 spreads figures across a wide scene.

lookingQuestion: Where does your eye land first — on the skeletal figures at left, the coiling black and yellow mass at center, or the small pink figure at lower right — and what in the image pulls it there?
ambiguities: The large black and yellow coiling form at center-right resists clear identification; it may be a figure, an animal, or a purely abstract shape.
